ConnectionStrings.// Default: Do NOT put a real connection string here for local dev. Use user-secrets instead:

Jwt.// SigningKey: Do NOT put a real signing key here. Use user-secrets instead:
Jwt.// Setup: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SigningKey" "<a long random string>" --project src/Api

Email.// All: Do NOT put real SMTP credentials here. Use user-secrets instead:
Email.// Setup: dotnet user-secrets set "Email:From" "<address>" --project src/Api (repeat for SmtpServer/Port/Username/Password)

Turnstile.// SecretKey: Do NOT put a real Cloudflare secret key here. Use user-secrets instead:
Turnstile.// Setup: dotnet user-secrets set "Turnstile:SecretKey" "<your secret key>" --project src/Api
Turnstile.// LocalDev: Cloudflare's always-passes dummy secret key for local dev is 1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA (pairs with the always-passes dummy sitekey 1x00000000000000000000AA already baked into web/src/environments)
